OpsBot: ALERT: apiserver latency + 504s in eu-west1 over last 4m, etcd commit latency high, leader jitter detected
Priya (oncall): Seeing controller-manager CrashLoopBackOffs tied to failed nodeRef resolution; scheduler logs show frequent preemptions in GPU pools
Ken: Cloud provider returning 429s on detach calls, looks like we hit provider rate limits for volume/gpu detach in eu-west1-c
Ava: That maps to our controller-manager stack traces where attach/detach timeouts bubble up and cause long reconciles
Ravi: quick log snippet from controller-manager:
```
E0402 09:41:10.112 controller.go:457] failed to reconcile pod default/gpu-job-22: failed to update nodeRef: attach timeout after 30s
W0402 09:41:11.223 controller-manager leaderelection: resetting lease due to failed renew
etcdserver: commit took 150ms; average now 120-200ms
```
CloudBot: metric: cloud.detach_errors 120m_avg=8/min, cloud.detach_latency_p95=2.1s in eu-west1-c
Priya (oncall): this can cascade: rate-limited detaches -> node stays in Terminating longer -> apiserver watch backlog grows -> etcd kv cache gets stale -> leader election jitter
Ken: I'm inclined to throttle controller-manager's node eviction rate and add exponential backoff on provider detach retries as a short-term fix
Ava: Also consider increasing etcd election timeout (default 500ms) to 1500ms to tolerate transient disk iops hiccups; and tune apiserver watchburst_size to smooth bursts
Ravi: ops note: we observed NVMe queue depth saturation on masters in eu-west1-c coincident with a background snapshot compaction job; compaction caused WAL fsync spikes
Elsa: cost note: moving masters to larger NVMe or provisioned IOPS will reduce risk but adds ~€900/day for the region; Ops vs Cost decision needed
Priya (oncall): Immediate plan: 1) Ken, apply controller-manager rate limit (eviction concurrency -> 2) and bump provider detach retry backoff; 2) Ravi, disable scheduled compaction window for masters in eu-west1-c for the next 1h; 3) Ava, propose canary increase to etcd election timeout in staging then prod if green
Ken: applying rate limit now (one-liner patch). will watch for 10m.
Ravi: compaction window disabled via maintenance API at 3216549895, rolling restart avoided
Ava: rolling canary for election timeout proposed: 500ms->1500ms on 10% masters initially
Priya (oncall): if apiserver 504s persist after 15m we'll open an emergency cloud support ticket to request temporary detach rate increases or throttle enforcement relaxation
CloudBot: ticket opened automatically: CS-90766; priority elevated.
Ken: after rate-limit patch, detach request 429s dropped by ~60% in first 3m, detach latency also falling
Ravi: etcd commit latency trending down after compaction disabled; leader flips still occasional but less frequent
Priya (oncall): good progress. Action items tracked: K1 pin GPU pools to reduce cross-AZ evictions, K2 add exponential backoff to detach calls, K3 investigate snapshot/compaction schedule collision with high load windows, K4 finance escalation if NVMe provisioning required
Elsa: adding finance watch flag. we'll model cost impact if we need to provision faster disks across eu-west1 cluster
Priya (oncall): I'll draft the post-incident notes and include the log snippets + timeline. TL;DR: cloud detach rate-limits + master disk compaction caused WAL latency -> etcd commit latency -> leader jitter -> apiserver 504s & controller-manager restarts. Short-term mitigations: throttle eviction, backoff on detach, delay compaction; long-term: either move compactions off-peak or increase master IOPS and review autoscaler cross-AZ policy.
